reason: My clients already send me their nota on WhatsApp, and I'm not going to ask villa staff and café cashiers to move to a Telegram group just for me. The month-end pile is annoying, but my routine works and it costs me nothing.
objection: It's Telegram and my clients live on WhatsApp, so I'd be the one forwarding everything by hand anyway. And at 5 to 40 clients the documents add up fast, so $19 quickly becomes $45 a month, which is real money from my income.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked inside WhatsApp, where my clients already send receipts, I'd try the 40 free documents on my messiest client.
